name: Cai Lin Ji Hot Dry Noodles Set
where: Cai Lin Ji official stores, or Wuhan Gift shops on Jianghan Road (武汉礼物)
about: These are Wuhan's famous sesame-sauce noodles. The set is meat-free and shelf-stable, so it is an easy souvenir to pack.
tip: Buy from an official Cai Lin Ji store to be sure of the product's quality.

name: Hanshu Embroidery Small Goods
where: Hanshu embroidery workshop, or Wuhan Gift shops that carry them (ask about stock first)
about: These are small items made with Wuhan's traditional embroidery. Scent sachets and other small goods are also sold at non-heritage events.
tip: Call ahead to check stock, since workshops and shops may not always have pouches on hand.
